act_title: The Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016.
title: Act not to prevent use of Aadhaar number for other purposes under law
text:
57. Act not to prevent use of Aadhaar number for other purposes under law.—Omitted by the

_Aadhaar and Other Laws (Amendment) Act 2019 (Act 14 of 2019), s. 25 (w.e.f. 25-07-2019)_
